Expand each product:
(u+4)(u-1) = u² + 3u - 4
(u-3)(u+6) = u² + 3u - 18

Subtracting gives (u² + 3u - 4) - (u² + 3u - 18) = 14.

Solution B reaches 14, which is correct. Solution A drops the u² and 3u terms incorrectly: it mishandles the sign on the 3u term, writing -3u after distribution but keeping -u + 4u as separate, then combining wrongly to get -4u + 14. In fact -u + 4u - 3u = 0, so A made an arithmetic error.

WINNER: B
